relation_statement: MoE expert gradients must be scaled by 1/dp_world_size after gradient sync, matching the averaging applied to dense gradients, under DP>1.
observable_signal: expert gradient norm exceeding the dense-equivalent averaged gradient by a factor of dp_world_size
validity_precondition: MoE expert parameters whose main_grads are local-only (num_experts >= 2)
evidence_from_issue: DistributedDataParallel.finish_grad_sync forgets to scale expert_grads by 1/dp_world_size
evidence_from_fix: syncs the regular grad buffers but never divides expert_grads; buggy expert grads are dp_world_size× larger than intended

relation_statement: The cached per-parameter gradient norms must be refreshed whenever a partition's gradient is externally overwritten, so the clip factor reflects the gradients actually being clipped, under CPU offload.
observable_signal: scaled_global_grad_norm vs a norm recomputed directly from the current partition gradients after modification
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with CPU optimizer offload and gradients modified via safe_set_local_grad between backward and step
evidence_from_issue: set_local_grad does not refresh norm_for_param_grads — gradient clipping uses pre-clipping norm
evidence_from_fix: aggregate reflects pre-modification gradients while the clip factor based on this stale norm is applied to the modified grads — silent mis-clipping

relation_statement: The router expert-bias buffer must preserve its full-precision (fp32) dtype under mixed-precision module wrapping.
observable_signal: expert_bias.dtype observed as bf16 instead of fp32 at runtime
validity_precondition: Float16Module-wrapped model with MoE TopKRouter using aux-loss-free expert_bias under bf16/fp16 training
evidence_from_issue: MoE expert_bias silently downcast to bf16 by Float16Module wrapper
evidence_from_fix: the expert_bias buffer was demoted to bf16; subsequent in-place updates accumulated in bf16, losing precision and silently distorting routing decisions

relation_statement: The dataset example budget must equal max_steps times device_train_batch_size under guard: batch_size>1.
observable_signal: Number of examples the loader yields before exhaustion vs max_duration*batch_size.
evidence_from_issue: Train DataLoader max_steps not multiplied by device_train_batch_size
evidence_from_fix: max_steps passed in optimizer steps not examples, so loader exhausts after ~1/batch_size of planned training; start_step also unscaled

relation_statement: Parameters designated as frozen (including those shared with the teacher path) must be excluded from gradient updates under guard that teacher-student block sharing is enabled.
observable_signal: nonzero parameter deltas or requires_grad=True on shared block parameters that were intended frozen
validity_precondition: stage-1 distillation training with blocks shared between teacher and student and a freeze pattern applied
evidence_from_issue: stage1 froze only teacher.* — student blocks updated against teacher gradient
evidence_from_fix: shared block parameters live under 'blocks.*' and were not matched by the 'teacher.*' freeze pattern, so blocks were unfrozen and trained against gradients including teacher-path contributions

relation_statement: The constructed layer's effective head dimension must match the dimension implied by the configured model width and head count under guard that the layer derives its own internal layout.
observable_signal: constructed layer head_dim attribute compared against d_model/n_heads at build time
validity_precondition: ladder configurator injects layer kwargs for a sequence mixer that derives head_dim internally
evidence_from_issue: ladder hard-coded head_dim from d_model/n_heads — wrong with FLA defaults
evidence_from_fix: injecting an externally-rounded head_dim made the constructed layer disagree with the configured d_model/n_heads, so the effective head dimension differed from what other code assumed

relation_statement: Per-parameter-group lr/weight_decay must retain their muP-scaled values after checkpoint restore (not be reset to the single base value for every group) when resuming a muP run.
observable_signal: Post-restore lr ratio between matrix-like and other param groups: all groups equal to cfg base lr (muP width scaling wiped) witnesses the violation.
validity_precondition: muP enabled (MuAdamW) with per-group width multipliers, training resumed from checkpoint
evidence_from_issue: Restart LR/weight-decay reset uses cfg.learning_rate for every param group, ignoring per-group muP scaling
evidence_from_fix: reset every group's lr/initial_lr/weight_decay to the base values, wiping muP scaling; fix tags each muP group with mup_lr/mup_weight_decay and uses those when resetting

relation_statement: Normalization-layer parameters must be assigned exclusively to the no-decay group (never receive weight decay) when no_decay_norm_and_bias is enabled.
observable_signal: Effective weight_decay hyperparameter attached to each norm parameter's group: a nonzero decay on q_norm/k_norm/ff_norm weights witnesses the misrouting.
validity_precondition: no_decay_norm_and_bias enabled and the model has norm parameters whose FQN ends at .norm.weight-style leaves (e.g. q_norm.weight)
evidence_from_issue: param-group classifier uses '.norm.' regex requiring trailing dot, treating q_norm/k_norm/ff_norm leaf weights as decay params
evidence_from_fix: the substring '.norm.' only matches when there is a child name after .norm ... the weight is silently routed to the decay group, applying weight_decay to a normalization layer's gain

relation_statement: Each data-parallel rank's offloaded optimizer state must be saved to and reloaded from a rank-exclusive location so every rank restores exactly its own shard.
observable_signal: per-rank optimizer state (exp_avg/exp_avg_sq) checksum before save vs after load; multiple ranks writing identical destination paths
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with NVMe optimizer offload across a multi-rank save/load cycle
evidence_from_issue: NVMe optimizer offload writes all ranks' tensors to one shared dir — last writer wins, load gets wrong rank's state
evidence_from_fix: every rank's local NVMe state copied into the same directory, overwritten file-by-file; on load each rank initializes optimizer state from another rank's slice

relation_statement: After a load_module_only checkpoint load, the fp32 master weights must equal the loaded 16-bit module weights before training resumes, including when bf16 is enabled.
observable_signal: elementwise difference between the fp32 master partitions and the upcast bf16 module weights immediately after load
evidence_from_issue: load_module_only with bf16 silently skips refresh_fp32_params, optimizer trains on uninitialized fp32 weights
evidence_from_fix: refresh_fp32_params() was guarded by self.fp16_enabled(), so for bf16 the high-precision master weights were never refreshed from the loaded 16-bit module

relation_statement: The activation tensor received by the next pipeline stage must equal the tensor produced by the sending stage under PP>1 with asynchronous isend/irecv.
observable_signal: Checksum of the sent activation buffer at isend time vs the received tensor on the next stage; corruption from buffer reuse before isend completion witnesses the violation.
validity_precondition: Hybrid Mamba model with virtual pipeline parallelism, post_process and post_layer_norm both True, inter-stage tensor sent via isend/irecv
evidence_from_issue: assigns make_viewless_tensor result to local 'output' but returns 'hidden_states', sending a non-viewless aliased tensor between hybrid VPP stages
evidence_from_fix: the make_viewless_tensor call had no effect ... the underlying buffer was reused before isend completed, and the next stage received corrupted activations
